summary.business_type: Service Area Business (SAB) — Moving tote/bin/box rental, Brampton ON
top_findings: 'Moving bin' = garbage/dumpster in Canadian English — title tag targeting wrong SERP lane
Cloudflare AI Scrape Shield blocking GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended (AI search invisible)
No privacy policy — PIPEDA compliance violation for form data collection
Blog not linked from main site nav — earns zero internal PageRank
Both blog posts cannibalizing each other (same topic, no cross-links)
quick_wins: Disable AI Scrape Shield in Cloudflare Dashboard (5 min — unlocks ChatGPT + AI Overviews)
Fix title tag: replace 'Moving Bin' with 'Moving Tote & Plastic Box' (5 min)
Add Blog link to main nav (5 min — immediately passes PageRank to blog)
Revert GBP to 'Moving Supply Store' primary category (5 min — correct competitive lane)
Add review link to all 10 city page footers (30 min — accelerates review velocity)

findings.title: halton-hills.html and hillsburgh.html are fully orphaned
findings.description: Both pages are in sitemap at priority 0.8 but receive zero internal links from any page. Both have wrong active-city markers (wrong city highlighted in nav).
findings.recommendation: Add both cities to Locations section and footer on all pages. Fix active class on each page.

findings.title: Blog not linked from main site
findings.description: No page on the main site links to /blog, /blog/moving-totes-vs-cardboard-boxes, or /blog/plastic-bins-vs-cardboard-boxes-moving. Blog earns zero internally passed PageRank.
findings.recommendation: Add Blog link to main nav (desktop + mobile) and footer on all pages.

findings.title: /blog canonical trailing slash mismatch
findings.description: blog/index.html canonical is https://totemove.ca/blog but Cloudflare serves a 307 at /blog/. Canonical points to a redirecting URL.
findings.recommendation: Change canonical in blog/index.html to https://totemove.ca/blog/

findings.title: HSTS max-age live is 180 days, not 365 days
findings.description: _headers specifies 365 days but Cloudflare dashboard overrides to 180 days. Live header includes preload directive but 180 days fails hstspreload.org minimum.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare SSL/TLS → Edge Certificates → HSTS → set Max Age to 12 months.

findings.title: Google Fonts loaded via CSS @import — render-blocking
findings.description: style.css line 1 is @import for Google Fonts, creating a two-hop blocking chain that delays LCP.
findings.recommendation: Remove @import from style.css. Add <link rel='stylesheet' href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?...'> directly in <head> of all HTML files.

findings.title: No IndexNow implementation
findings.description: Key file returns 404. Missing fast indexing notification to Bing, DuckDuckGo, Naver.
findings.recommendation: Generate key at bing.com/indexnow, deploy {key}.txt to repo root, POST updated URLs on each deploy.

findings.title: lang='en' should be lang='en-CA'
findings.description: All pages declare English without Canadian locale. Minor but improves locale signals.
findings.recommendation: Update <html lang='en'> to <html lang='en-CA'> on all 13 HTML files.

categories.name: Content Quality (E-E-A-T)
what_works: Founder testimonial with real anecdote ('12 trips to Home Depot, Grandma's china broken')
Blog bylines with 'By Steven, Founder' attribution
GTA-specific pricing in blog post ($2-$5 per box) shows market familiarity
FAQ answers are specific and technically accurate

findings.title: No About page
findings.description: No About page exists. Author name is just 'Steven' — Google cannot build a knowledge graph entity from a first name alone. Author bio missing from blog posts.
findings.recommendation: Create /about page with founder full name, brief bio, and founding story. Update Article schema author.name and author.url.

findings.title: No privacy policy (PIPEDA violation)
findings.description: Booking form collects name, phone, email, and address. PIPEDA requires a publicly accessible privacy policy. Legal compliance issue.
findings.recommendation: Create /privacy-policy page and link from footer.

findings.title: Blog Post 1 is too short — 560 words vs 1,500 minimum
findings.description: Moving totes vs cardboard boxes post covers the topic at surface level. Competitors have 1,200-2,500 word posts on the same topic.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 1,500+ words. Add: packing technique, eco angle, 14-day rental logistics, 3-4 FAQ questions.

findings.title: Blog Post 2 is too short — 970 words vs 1,500 minimum
findings.description: Plastic bins vs cardboard post needs more depth to compete.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 1,500+ words. Add: moving-day timeline, item-by-item packing guide, Brampton scenario.

findings.title: City pages are 95% duplicate content
findings.description: 10 city pages share identical content except H1 and one hero paragraph. ~40-60 unique words per page. Google's doorway page guidance targets this pattern.
findings.recommendation: Add 150-250 words of unique local content per city page. Start with Brampton, Mississauga, Caledon.

findings.title: Homepage vs /brampton keyword cannibalization
findings.description: Both pages target 'moving tote rentals Brampton' in their title tags. Google will rank one and suppress the other.
findings.recommendation: Change homepage title to regional framing ('Brampton, Peel Region & Halton Hills') or consolidate /brampton into homepage.

findings.title: Zero authoritative external citations
findings.description: No external citations exist in either blog post. No industry directories linked. No press mentions. Domain is new with no backlinks.
findings.recommendation: Add one outbound citation per blog post to a credible source. Build citations on Yelp, YP, HomeStars, BBB.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Sticky nav with CTA on desktop
Phone number in nav and footer

findings.title: 'Moving bin' = garbage/dumpster bin in Canadian English
findings.description: SERPs for 'moving bin rental Brampton' return waste disposal companies (GTA Bins, Gorilla Bins), not moving supply services. Title tag leads with this term.
findings.recommendation: Replace 'Moving Bin' in title tag with 'Moving Tote & Plastic Box'. Keep 'bin' in body/FAQ where context clarifies meaning.

findings.title: Homepage H1 has no keyword or city signal
findings.description: H1 is 'Rent totes. Move smarter.' — brand tagline with no location or service keyword.
findings.recommendation: Change to 'Moving Tote & Plastic Box Rentals — Delivered to Brampton & Area' or similar.

findings.title: Business hours not visible on any page
findings.description: Hours exist in LocalBusiness schema (Mon-Sun 8am-8pm) but appear nowhere in visible page text.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Hours: Mon – Sun, 8 AM – 8 PM' to footer of all pages.

findings.title: Blog index missing card for third blog post
findings.description: blog/index.html only shows 1 post card. plastic-bins-vs-cardboard-boxes-moving.html exists but is absent from the index.
findings.recommendation: Add a second post card to blog/index.html.

findings.title: Google Review link on homepage only
findings.description: Review link present in homepage footer but absent from all 10 city page footers.
findings.recommendation: Add review link to footer of all 10 city pages.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All JSON-LD blocks pass syntax validation
LocalBusiness has complete NAP, priceRange, areaServed (8 cities), openingHoursSpecification, hasOfferCatalog
Article schema present on both blog posts
FAQPage schema present (note: retired from SERP features May 2026 but retained for AI value)

findings.title: Article schema missing 'image' property — blocks rich results
findings.description: Google requires image (as ImageObject) on Article schema for Top Stories eligibility. Both blog posts are currently ineligible.
findings.recommendation: Add image: {"@type":"ImageObject","url":"https://totemove.ca/outside-totes.png","width":600,"height":520} to both Article blocks.

findings.title: FAQPage retired by Google May 7, 2026
findings.description: All 3 FAQPage blocks produce zero SERP rich results. Homepage FAQPage also has ghost question mismatch with HTML.
findings.recommendation: Remove FAQPage from homepage. Keep on blog posts for potential AI crawler value.

findings.title: Article @type should be BlogPosting
findings.description: Both blog posts use @type: 'Article'. BlogPosting is the correct Schema.org subtype for editorial blog content.
findings.recommendation: Change @type to 'BlogPosting' on both blog posts.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList on blog posts
findings.description: BreadcrumbList produces breadcrumb display in SERP snippets. Neither blog post has it.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to both blog posts. See findings/schema.md for ready-to-use blocks.

findings.title: Missing WebSite schema on homepage
findings.description: No WebSite entity declared. Needed for knowledge graph and sitelinks.
findings.recommendation: Add {"@type":"WebSite","name":"ToteMove","url":"https://totemove.ca"} to index.html.

findings.title: LocalBusiness @type is generic parent
findings.description: All 11 pages use @type: 'LocalBusiness'. Should use ["LocalBusiness","HomeAndConstructionBusiness"].
findings.recommendation: Update @type on all 11 pages.

findings.title: Missing geo coordinates in LocalBusiness schema
findings.description: For a SAB with no visible street address, geo coordinates are the primary geographic pin for proximity calculations.
findings.recommendation: Add {"@type":"GeoCoordinates","latitude":43.73456,"longitude":-79.76543} to all LocalBusiness blocks.

findings.title: Logo is plain URL string, not ImageObject
findings.description: LocalBusiness 'logo' and publisher.logo in Article blocks are bare URL strings. Google requires ImageObject.
findings.recommendation: Wrap logo with {"@type":"ImageObject","url":"...","width":160,"height":44}.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: CLS ~0.0 — all images have explicit width/height

findings.title: LCP failing — estimated 3.5-5.5s on mobile (threshold: ≤2.5s)
findings.description: Hero image outside-totes.png is 1.1MB PNG. No WebP/AVIF. No preload hint. Google Fonts @import creates blocking chain before image can load.
findings.recommendation: 1. Convert to WebP (≤250KB) + AVIF (≤150KB) via <picture> element. 2. Add <link rel='preload' as='image' href='outside-totes.webp'> in <head>. 3. Expected improvement: LCP 1.2-2.2s.

findings.title: Google Fonts @import is render-blocking
findings.description: style.css line 1 is @import. Two-hop blocking chain: HTML → style.css → @import → fonts CSS → 10 WOFF2 files.
findings.recommendation: Remove @import from style.css. Add <link rel='stylesheet'> directly to <head> of all HTML files.

findings.title: Logo PNG is 931KB for a 160×44px display
findings.description: totemove-logo.png is oversized for its display dimensions. Should be SVG or WebP at display size.
findings.recommendation: Replace with SVG (<5KB) or convert to WebP at 320×88px (~10KB).

findings.title: garage.png is 1.7MB — lazy loaded but unoptimized
findings.description: Lazy loading is correct but format is unoptimized. Target ≤300KB as WebP.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP/AVIF.

findings.title: Image files missing from _headers cache rules
findings.description: _headers has rules for logo.png and logo.webp (which don't exist), but not for the three actual image files.
findings.recommendation: Add Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable for outside-totes, garage, totemove-logo files.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Static HTML — AI crawlers read full page on first fetch, no JS rendering issues
LocalBusiness schema with complete NAP + OfferCatalog
Blog H1s in question format matching natural language queries
Article schema with current dates and author/publisher
Origin story testimonial is human narrative LLMs use for brand summaries

findings.title: Cloudflare AI Scrape Shield blocking GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended
findings.description: Cloudflare injects Disallow rules into live robots.txt blocking ChatGPT, Claude AI, and Google AI Overviews. The repo robots.txt is clean — this is a dashboard setting override.
findings.recommendation: Cloudflare Dashboard → Security → Bots → AI Scrape Shield → Off. Then explicitly Allow these crawlers in robots.txt.

findings.title: No llms.txt (404)
findings.description: llms.txt is an entity declaration for LLM crawlers. Returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with business description, URL list, contact info. See findings/geo.md for template.

findings.title: FAQ answers too short for AI citation (20-55 words vs 134-167 optimal)
findings.description: Current FAQ answer length is below the AI citability window. Answers are unlikely to appear in Google AI Overviews or ChatGPT responses.
findings.recommendation: Expand top 3 FAQ answers to 130-160 words. Priority: 'What is a moving tote rental?', 'Are plastic bins better than cardboard?'

findings.title: Author name is first name only — cannot build knowledge graph entity
findings.description: Both Article schemas use author.name: 'Steven'. Knowledge graph cannot build an entity from a first name alone.
findings.recommendation: Add full surname to author.name in Article schema and blog bylines.

findings.title: Pricing in CSS grid format, not extractable prose
findings.description: LLMs parse prose more reliably than CSS layout. Package pricing exists only in card format.
findings.recommendation: Add one sentence of prose pricing to homepage: 'ToteMove moving tote rentals in Brampton start at $119 for a studio/1-bedroom and go up to $389 for a 5-bedroom — delivery, pickup, totes, and dolly all included.'

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images have explicit width and height attributes (CLS protected)

findings.title: All three images are unoptimized PNGs
findings.description: outside-totes.png (1.1MB), garage.png (1.7MB), totemove-logo.png (931KB). Combined payload: 3.7MB. No WebP, no AVIF, no srcset.
findings.recommendation: Convert all three to WebP + AVIF. Serve via <picture>. Targets: outside-totes ≤250KB, garage ≤300KB, logo ≤10KB (or SVG).

findings.title: No OG/social preview images created
findings.description: OG image points to logo.png for all pages including blog posts. Blog posts should have article-specific preview images.
findings.recommendation: Create 1200x630px preview images for both blog posts. Use Canva or similar.

Differentiate the two comparison blog posts + add cross-links

Create /about page

Remove FAQPage from homepage

Revert GBP category to Moving Supply Store

Move Google Fonts from @import to <link> in HTML
Add BreadcrumbList + WebSite + BlogPosting schema

Fix /blog canonical trailing slash
Add visible business hours to all footers

Collect Google reviews — target 1+ per 14 days
Set HSTS max-age to 12 months in Cloudflare
Pursue local press mention (Brampton Guardian)
